Things to Know Before You Play

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318896/951b7ab66b589285a75f3ac1dbc98180d708f10b.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

Welcome to Command & Conquer: Tiberium Alliances! Whether you’re a veteran of the C&C universe or stepping onto the battlefield for the first time, we’ve got some essential tips to help you maximize your power, expand your base, and conquer the battlefield.

[h3]Build a Strong Foundation[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318896/352f81d485626b557126211984ce403f695c9a97.png[/img]

Your base is the heart of your operation. Efficient resource management is crucial—focus on balancing Tiberium (for construction) and Crystal (for unit production). Power keeps everything running, while Credits help with research and expansions. Don’t neglect your Repair Time—a well-maintained army is key to sustained battles.

[h3]Base Placement & Expansion[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318896/f20e3129c41e73fca989a2f7ea75a8ada3e2e514.png[/img]

Strategic positioning matters. When starting out, prioritize locations near resource fields and alliance-controlled areas for protection. As you grow, expanding into higher-level territory will provide better resources but also tougher challenges.

[h3]Master Combat Tactics[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318896/ff99e4a97b34db65810700d1c842ede8bd742794.png[/img]

Battles in Tiberium Alliances are all about positioning and planning. Whether you're obtaining resources and research points from the Forgotten bases, or engaging in PvP, here are some key combat tips: • Scout before you attack – Always analyze enemy defenses before committing your forces. • Mix your units – Deploy your infantry, vehicles, and aircraft in multiple waves to maximize power efficiency. • Flank and destroy – Target the Construction Yard or Defense HQ to cripple the enemy base and minimize losses.

[h3]Resupply & Reinforce[/h3]

Your troops won’t last forever. Keep a steady flow of reinforcements ready and always have a backup army in training. Using multi-wave attacks can also help wear down strong defenses.

[h3]Join an Alliance & Dominate[/h3]

Success in Tiberium Alliances isn’t just about individual strength—it’s about teamwork. Joining an alliance gives you access to shared resources, coordinated attacks, and territory control. Here’s how to make the most of it: • Support your allies – Trade resources, reinforce defenses, and strategize together. • Participate in world domination – Work with your alliance to capture The Forgotten Fortresses and secure global control. • Stay active & communicate – Strong alliances thrive on teamwork and strategy. Make sure to check in regularly and engage with your team.

[h3]Upgrade & Adapt Your Strategy[/h3]

The battlefield is always evolving, and so should your tactics. Regularly upgrade your Command Center, Defense HQ, and Research Lab to unlock new units and defensive capabilities. Experiment with different attack formations and adapt based on enemy strategies.

Whether you’re here to conquer solo or lead an unstoppable alliance, these tips will set you on the path to victory. Now, Commander—mobilize your forces and take control!
